instruction: The Name column (column D) is too narrow and the names are cut off. Widen column D to make all names fully visible.

metadata.explanation: Task requires widening column D (Name column) to make names fully visible. Original width is 13.0 (default). Task expects column width > 20 after widening. Similar difficulty to zoom task - simple column formatting operation.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts column D width from the Excel file
Metric comparison logic is appropriate (gt method for width > 20)
Postconfig properly saves file before verification
Edge cases handled (None values, default width)
However, evaluator uses proxy metric (width > 20) rather than verifying the actual semantic requirement (all names fully visible)
Expected value of 20 appears arbitrary - not derived from actual maximum name length in the data
No verification that the width threshold is sufficient for the longest name in column D
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Ideally, calculate the maximum name length in column D and set expected width based on actual content requirements
Add metadata explaining why width > 20 is sufficient for this specific dataset
Consider reading column D content to verify the longest name fits within the new width
Alternative: Document in metadata the actual longest name and its required width
